**[P1] Keep operation registration atomic with checkpoint delivery**

The separate `get()` and branch lose the previous atomic ordering. If a replayed operation registers between this lookup and `operationStorage.put`, its `execute()` can read the old non-terminal state while this callback takes the null branch and never completes the new instance. Because the checkpoint token has advanced, that waiter may poll or suspend indefinitely despite the terminal update. Coordinate `registerOperation` and checkpoint handling with the same per-ID atomic operation so either the instance is notified or terminal state is published before registration returns.
